en.answer: In this case, since <<7849>> was previously Special Summoned by its own effect, it will be banished when it leaves the field. Therefore, when the effect of <<11734>> applies, <<7849>> will be banished instead of being shuffled into the Deck.
en.question: When <<11734>> resolves, will its effect shuffle a <<7849>> I control after it was Special Summoned by its own effect?
en.title: When <<11734>> resolves, will its effect shuffle a <<7849>> I control after it was Special Summoned by its own effect?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、「<<7849>>」は『この効果で特殊召喚したこのカードは、フィールドから離れた場合に除外される』効果が適用されている状態ですので、「<<11734>>」の効果が適用された場合、持ち主のデッキには戻らず、除外される事になります。
